version.changelog: Security section now states that the public-data tools read other people's public content without a connected account (read-only, paid from credit).

llm.summary: This skill clearly describes a LinkedIn integration that can read profile/media data and create or delete LinkedIn content only through disclosed ClawLink tools with user confirmation for writes.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses a hosted ClawLink OAuth flow, connected LinkedIn account access, public-data lookups, and paid ClawLink credit; these are disclosed and proportionate to the integration but users should understand the third-party service and billing model.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires adding the ClawLink plugin to OpenClaw's allowed tools and restarting the gateway; this is disclosed and coherent with enabling the integration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions tell the agent to discover available tools, preview or describe unfamiliar and write actions, and require explicit user confirmation before posts, comments, or deletion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The plugin installation, tool allow-list change, gateway restart, and ClawLink-stored OAuth token persist beyond one chat, but the behavior is disclosed and tied to the integration's purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is LinkedIn account and public LinkedIn data management, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: profile reads, media reads, ad targeting lookup, posting, commenting, and deletion.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust ClawLink to broker LinkedIn OAuth access and understand that write actions can affect your public LinkedIn presence; only approve previews that exactly match the post, comment, or deletion you intend.
